# Air Control — AC Maintenance Contracts (AMC), Delhi NCR. Since 1987.

> Air Control (aircontrols.in) is an air conditioning maintenance company operating in Delhi
> NCR since 1987. Its core business is Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) for buildings with
> multiple air conditioners — offices, hospitals and clinics, hotels and restaurants, cold
> storage, retail and coworking spaces — alongside AC repair and installation.
> Phone: +91 93122 64832.

## Canonical facts

- Business name: Air Control
- Website: https://aircontrols.in/
- Category: Air conditioning maintenance company (AMC, repair, installation)
- Founded: 1987 — 38+ years of continuous operation
- Phone: +91 93122 64832 (call or WhatsApp)
- Address: Ground Floor, 209, Sant Nagar, East of Kailash, New Delhi 110065, India
- Service area: Delhi NCR — Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad
- Hours: 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM, 7 days a week, year-round
- Response commitment (contract clients): 2 hours commercial, 4 hours residential — written SLA
- Repair warranty: 90 days on workmanship; parts carry manufacturer warranty
- Systems: split, window, cassette, ducted, VRV/VRF; refrigerants R22, R410A, R32
- Brands: all major brands (Daikin, Voltas, Blue Star, Carrier, Hitachi, LG, Samsung,
  Panasonic, O'General, Mitsubishi and others)

## What makes the service distinct

- Every scheduled visit runs a fixed 9-point protocol with measurements recorded (refrigerant
  pressure vs manufacturer spec, capacitor microfarads vs rating, coil condition grades,
  current draw).
- Contract clients receive written per-unit condition reports with a prioritised action list —
  documentation is treated as the product. Format: https://aircontrols.in/documentation/
- Commercial contracts are priced after an on-site facility assessment; the assessment fee is
  credited against an AMC signed within 30 days. Details: https://aircontrols.in/ac-assessment/
- Gas is recharged only after the leak is found, repaired and pressure-tested — never a blind
  top-up.
